name: znimok
description: Screenshots for AI agents: capture screens, windows and regions, annotate, hide secrets, read text and export — on your computer, with your approval.
long_description: Znimok takes screenshots, lets an agent mark them up (arrows, frames, text, counters, hidden areas), finds and hides keys, passwords, e-mails, cards and faces, recognises text on the device and exports PNG, JPEG, WebP or a self-contained HTML page. Everything stays in your local Znimok library. The first time an agent wants to take a screenshot or read your library, Znimok asks you (this time / this session / always); every call is written to a local journal without its contents. The MCP server is off until you switch it on in Znimok → Settings → Agents.
